# PDF Chat Agent Pack

Reusable, assistant-neutral workflow instructions for implementing a Streamlit PDF chat application with page-level citations and supporting text.

## Install into a repository
Extract this archive at the repository root. Read `agents.md` for orchestration and `skills.md` for the feature index. Each feature has its own `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` entry point.

## Scope
This package contains agent and skill instructions rather than a generated application implementation. The instructions define a provider-neutral baseline using Streamlit, PyMuPDF, and FAISS.
